subject: Vendor intake: InfraHaven onboarding, vendor forms & PO pathway
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Angela Rivera <angela@infrahaven.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor intake: InfraHaven onboarding, vendor forms & PO pathway

Hi Angela —

Welcome — excited to kick off the procurement intake for InfraHaven. To get vendor setup and PO routing completed quickly we need a few items from your side and I also attached the standard Redwood intake form for you to fill where helpful. Below is what we typically exchange at the start; let me know if any of this is already available and we can skip items.

What we need from InfraHaven:
- Completed vendor intake (attached: Redwood_Procurement_Onboarding_Form.pdf)
- W‑9 or local tax equivalent (for US vendors) and vendor TIN
- Bank details (voided check or bank letter) for ACH wiring
- AP contact and preferred invoice email address
- Sample invoice with PO number placeholder 
- Any required compliance attestations (data processing, SOC2 if applicable)

What we will provide / do on our side:
- Create vendor record in Redwood finance system and assign vendor code (target: 48 business hours after receipt of required docs)
- Provide a vendor number and sample PO format for your invoicing
- Route initial POs to the invoice email and set remittance terms per the agreement
- Share DocuSign for the master services agreement (if not already executed)

Quick operational questions:
1) Do you require the PO number in the invoice subject line, body, or in a specific invoice field?
2) Does InfraHaven have an existing SAP/Oracle vendor number we should map to?

I've cc'd Laura from Finance and Lauren on Partnerships to keep operations aligned. If it's easier we can schedule a 20-minute kickoff to walk through the form — are you available Thursday or Friday afternoon PT?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Redwood_Procurement_Onboarding_Form.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

From: Angela Rivera <angela@infrahaven.com>

Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: InfraHaven onboarding, vendor forms & PO pathway

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the clear list. Attaching the vendor info workbook we keep for customers (InfraHaven_Vendor_Info.xlsx) and our operations contact details. Quick answers:
- We can include the PO number in the invoice body and in the invoice subject line (both OK).
- We do have an existing vendor ID in our ERP, but that won't affect Redwood's vendor number — we can share it for cross-referencing.

Two quick clarifications: 
1) For bank details, do you need a voided check specifically or will a bank letter with account routing work?
2) Is Redwood able to accept invoices via email (billing@infrahaven.com) or do you require upload to a vendor portal?

We can also complete the attached intake by end of day Friday. If you want to tee up a quick call Friday 11am PT, Sam and I can join.

Best,
Angela Rivera
VP, Partnerships — InfraHaven
angela@infrahaven.com | +1 (206) 555-0123

Attachments: InfraHaven_Vendor_Info.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

Hi Angela / InfraHaven AP team —

Great, thank you for the quick turn. Bank letter is fine (bank letter or voided check), and we accept emailed invoices to AP email addresses. Our finance team will process invoices sent to invoices@redwood.com; please cc billing@infrahaven.com if you want internal copies to track.

To be explicit on PO handling: 
- Redwood will generate a PO from our procurement system after vendor record creation and internal approvals.
- PO numbers should be included in the invoice subject line and the invoice body. Example subject: "Invoice — PO 2026-RED-54321".
- For ACH payments we need a bank letter (or voided check) and the completed ACH remittance form that is part of the intake.

I've opened an internal request with Finance (Laura is cc'd) to assign a vendor code once we receive your updated docs. Laura — can you confirm the expected SLA for vendor creation once all docs are in?

Angela — attaching the DocuSign link for our standard MSA; if InfraHaven has an executed MSA on file please let me know and we will skip.

If helpful we can lock the 11am PT Friday slot for a 20-minute sync.

Thanks,
Rishi

Redwood Inference

Hi InfraHaven team —

Thanks — received the TIN and workbook. Laura: finance SLA please?

Laura Bennett (Finance):
- We'll create the vendor record as soon as we have the completed intake, TIN, and bank letter. Typical SLA is 2 business days after receiving completed docs and security signoff (we'll expedite for new partners).
- Once the vendor code is created we will send the Redwood vendor ID back to InfraHaven to map with INF-88977.
- First PO issuance typically occurs within 48 hours of vendor creation, provided the deal record in HubSpot is active and legal obligations are satisfied.

Next steps for InfraHaven (short checklist):
1) Return the completed Redwood procurement intake (if you haven't already) — attached in Rishi's original email.
2) Attach bank letter or voided check and W‑9/TIN PDF (received).
3) Confirm preferred invoice recipient (invoices@redwood.com OK).
4) Sign the MSA via DocuSign if necessary (link below).
5) Expect vendor code from Finance within 2 business days; Redwood to follow with sample PO format.

Links & attachments: PO_Submission_SOP.md (attached, includes invoice sample), DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/embedded/sign/abc123, HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company/contacts/INFRA-2345

I'll mark this as in-progress and circle back once Finance confirms the new vendor ID. If you'd like to add any additional billing rules (net terms, special remittance), please flag now.

Best regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
